sources.title: History note
sources.text:
Heart failure was diagnosed in 2023.
No previous myocardial infarction is recorded.
Appendectomy was performed in 2004.
The patient stopped smoking in 2018.
The patient's mother had type 2 diabetes.

sources.title: Prescription records, not confirmed current use
sources.text:
The July 1 prescription records furosemide 40 mg every morning.
The July 1 prescription records ramipril 5 mg daily.
The July 1 prescription records spironolactone 25 mg daily.
The July 1 prescription records aspirin 75 mg daily.

sources.title: Medication reconciliation
sources.text:
On August 2, the patient reported taking ramipril 2.5 mg daily after reducing the dose because of dizziness.
Cardiology stopped aspirin on July 20; this conflicts with the earlier prescription list.

sources.title: Allergy record
sources.text: Penicillin caused a childhood rash; no anaphylaxis was reported with that reaction.

sources.title: Laboratory report; final results
sources.text:
Potassium was 4.8 mmol/L on August 3.
Creatinine was 104 micromol/L on August 3.
Estimated glomerular filtration rate was 62 mL/min/1.73 m2 on August 3.
Haemoglobin was 124 g/L on August 3.

sources.title: Clinic measurements
sources.text:
Blood pressure was 118/70 mmHg on August 4.
Heart rate was 76 beats per minute on August 4.
Oxygen saturation was 97% on room air on August 4.
Weight was 72.4 kg on August 4.

sources.title: Echocardiogram report
sources.text:
Left ventricular ejection fraction was 40% on the July 15 echocardiogram.
The July 15 echocardiogram recorded mild mitral regurgitation.
The July 15 echocardiogram showed no pericardial effusion.

sources.title: Cardiology consultation plan
sources.text:
Cardiology follow-up was planned in six weeks from August 4.
Repeat renal function blood tests were planned in one week from August 4.
The recorded plan asks the patient to measure weight daily.

sources.title: Stored follow-up form
sources.text:
Dizziness had resolved by August 4.
No orthopnoea was reported on August 4.
Leg oedema had improved by August 4.

sources.title: Immunization record
sources.text:
Influenza vaccination was declined on August 4.
Shingles vaccination was offered on August 4, but administration is not recorded.

sources.title: Hospital discharge report
sources.text:
The patient was admitted on July 5 for fluid overload.
The patient was discharged home on July 9.
